response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT p.death_country, AVG(v.points_won) AS avg_points_won FROM player_award_vote v JOIN player p ON p.player_id = v.player_id WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.death_country) SELECT death_country, avg_points_won, avg_points_won - (SELECT AVG(avg_points_won) FROM c) AS diff_from_avg_of_avgs FROM c ORDER BY death_country;

assumptions.assumption: Players with a NULL death_country (mostly living players) are excluded, since they have no death country to show.
Each country's average is taken over all of its award-vote rows (not per player first). AVG ignores NULL points_won.
The difference is signed (country average minus the unweighted mean of the country averages), with no rounding.
